correctness.rationale: The Desargues inclusion graph and all 6,212 augmented independent faces are generated from first principles. A deterministic matching of 3,102 pairs on the 6,211 nonempty faces is exhaustively acyclic on all 30,360 nonempty Hasse covers; its critical cells occur once in dimensions zero and four and five times in dimension five. All five integral Morse attaching coefficients vanish by exact signed elimination, proving integral reduced homology Z in dimension four and Z^5 in dimension five, with no other reduced homology. All 240 graph automorphisms are rebuilt, edge-preservation checked, and their reduced Lefschetz traces computed by oriented fixed faces and independently by orbit-conflict independence polynomials; both yield L(p,c^s)=(-1)^s(sgn(p)-fix(p)). The one-dimensional H4 character is forced to be sign times complement sign using involution eigenvalues and the three-cycle trace; H5 then has the complement-twisted five-point permutation character. Rational character uniqueness and the rank-one integral character justify exactly the claimed module strengths. The complete standalone verifier was executed successfully.

originality.rationale: The nearest full same-object published results give the exact nonequivariant Desargues homotopy type S^4 wedge five S^5 but do not supply the integral H4 character or rational H5 character. Barmak 2010 determines a broad suspension property for triangle-free graph independence complexes, not these characters. Kumar–Singh–Verma compute edge-ideal linear-strand Betti numbers for this exact bipartite Kneser graph, which are not its homology symmetry characters. The classical symmetry-group paper computes graph automorphisms, not the induced topological module. Primary full scientific texts were inspected where accessible. Tsukuda 2017 is a genuinely relevant general reduction whose full text could not be accessed, so no claim of whole-document noncoverage is made; the abstract offers a homotopy equivalence but no explicit Desargues equivariant representation. Detailed searches found no specific stronger covering statement; absolute novelty remains contingent on unindexed literature.

value.rationale: A full automorphism representation is a natural invariant of a canonical symmetric cubic graph. The previously known mixed-dimensional homotopy type fixes only ranks, whereas this theorem distinguishes an integral orientation sign in degree four, a rational five-point permutation representation in degree five, and negation by the natural central complement involution on both integral groups. It supplies exact 14-class character formulas and determines invariant subspaces. The object and parameter are canonical; no arbitrary numerical slice or routine reparameterization is involved. Neither an infinite-family result nor the still-unknown integral fifth-homology lattice is claimed.
